name: Burrow Reach
description: Act 1, E9 Designer Marks. Burrower country: terraced ground in the east, and in the north a grid of furrows too straight and too evenly spaced to be natural (`furrow-grid`): soil engineering by a terraforming run. Burrow holes pock the plain; acid pans in the south-west are where spitters digest the mineral crust (`spitter-pans`). Four nests, bigger packs, burrowers guarding the furrows and a brood mound (`brood-mound`) in the far north-east. Rich deposits: the engineered soil left ore near the surface. Suggested hooks: a biology research or a site trigger at `furrow-grid` for E9, and the brood mound as a "quiet the region" objective.

sites.label: Acid pans: spitters digest the crust
